name: Grand Hyatt Guangzhou
positioning: Grand Hyatt hotel in the central business district of Zhujiang New Town, Guangzhou, with a Sky Lobby looking out at Canton Tower
best_for: Travelers who want a base in Zhujiang New Town's central business district
Guests who want Canton Tower or city views from their room

facts.text: The hotel is located in the central business district of Pearl River New Town, also called Zhujiang New Town, in Guangzhou.
Guangzhou Opera House, Guangdong Museum, Haixinsha and Xinghai Concert Hall are easy to visit from the hotel.
Huacheng Square APM Station is 0.35 kilometers from the hotel.
The Sky Lobby is on the 22nd floor and looks out over Canton Tower.
The Grand Club is on the 20th floor and is for guests staying in suites and Club Floor rooms.
Grand Club guests have an exclusive check-in and check-out in the Grand Club Lounge.
The pool area has a sauna, a whirlpool, a cold plunge pool and grooming stations.
The fitness center is on the hotel's top floor and has city views.
The rooms provide panoramic city views of Zhujiang New Town.
The Presidential Suite has a kitchen, butler service and Grand Club access.
Family rooms are connecting rooms, one with a king bed and the other with two single beds.
The Penthouse restaurant serves authentic Cantonese cuisine.

highlights.text: The hotel's Sky Lobby offers panoramic views of Canton Tower.
The Guanxi Lounge sits on a suspended bridge between the hotel's towers.
The Grand Club looks out over the greenery of Huacheng Square and the cityscape of Zhujiang New Town.
Tower View rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Canton Tower.
The indoor pool is surrounded by large windows that let natural light flood in.

considerations.text: The hotel recommends that international guests use local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map.
Grand Club lounge access is for guests in suites and Club Floor rooms.
WhataHotel notes that this large urban hotel may lack an intimate boutique atmosphere.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Grand Hyatt Guangzhou
